entities.summary: Dru Joyce III is an American men's college basketball coach and former professional player who is the head coach for the Duquesne Dukes. His coaching career began in 2019–20 with the Cleveland State Vikings after a 12-year professional playing career in Europe. He retired as the all-time assists leader in Germany's Basketball Bundesliga. Joyce is a close friend of LeBron James and was his teammate at St. Vincent–St. Mary High School.
